title: Graham Hancock's lost Ice Age civilization

tellings.quote: Graham thinks this is these were built by um ancient peoples the Atlanteanss or whoever

plain: The writer Graham Hancock argues that ancient stone sites such as Göbekli Tepe, and others around the world, were built by an advanced civilisation lost at the end of the Ice Age, an idea he set out in his book Fingerprints of the Gods. The skeptic Michael Shermer sums up Hancock's view to Michels in passing, saying Hancock thinks these were built by "the Atlanteans or whoever." Shermer brings it up in a debate, as a view he does not share.
